tasks.task: Summarise a contract in plain words before signing

items.when: When you have the full contract and need a plain summary with every date, payment and duty by clause
When the summary is done, to rate the key clauses and risks by how serious they are
When the deal creates or uses work product, to check ownership, licence and indemnity clauses
When the document is an NDA and the owner wants a quick green, yellow or red call
When the summary copies the contract's wording, to say plainly what each side must do
Before it goes to the owner, to tie each statement to a clause number or cut it

tasks.task: Build a tracker of contract dates, renewals and duties

items.when: When each contract needs its dates, notice periods and payments pulled into one table
When you must see what was signed with a vendor, what is missing and what expires soon
Each month, to list renewals and notice dates due, the traps in each and what to ask
When a renewal is near, to plan the notice deadline and keep, renegotiate or replace options

tasks.task: Compare two contract versions or two offers

items.when: When a new version arrives, to trace each clause change and list the issues for legal review
When two suppliers have sent proposals, to compare cost and risk and name points to negotiate
When each offer first needs its own plain summary and table before you compare them
When one version adds risky terms, to flag them and say when to call a lawyer

tasks.task: List the questions to take to a lawyer

items.when: When a contract is in hand, to rank risky and missing terms and write questions for the lawyer
When contracts arrive often, to rate each one and list the clauses to question
When a legal request has come in, to draft a reply and flag when a lawyer must review

tasks.task: Turn a regulation into a plain summary and duty checklist

items.when: When it is not clear which rules apply to a plan, to list rules, approvals and risk areas
When you have the rule text and need a summary in its order and a checklist with proof to keep
When a practice spans countries, to check which laws apply and what to ask a lawyer
When the rule is a known framework, to get an evidence checklist with gaps ranked
Before the checklist is shared, to tie each duty to its section or cut it

tasks.task: Summarise what changed in a new version of a rule

items.when: When a new version is out and you need what was added, removed and changed, with deadlines
When the change must be mapped to the policies it touches and what to change in each
When rules change often, to find the gaps and check small redrafts each time
When a gap is found, to mark up the current policy with small edits for review

tasks.task: Build the data map and privacy records

items.when: When the business needs a data map, processing records, a vendor list and a request log
When code and data use can be inspected, to list privacy risks and track data requests
When the business has US customers, to see if California law applies and what it adds
When the register covers marketing, to see who agreed to email and SMS and who did not
When the records are built, to find gaps against the privacy management standard

tasks.task: Review a new use of customer data

items.when: Before the review, to see what the register already says about this data and its purpose
When a new feature uses personal data, to write the assessment with conditions and owners
When one use needs a regulator's eye, to list the duties, the proof missing and what to fix
When the new use may not match the published policy, to find the gap and fix wording
When a safeguard is proposed, to ask what it protects, what it costs and what it assumes

tasks.task: Check a vendor's data terms before signing

items.when: Before signing a vendor that handles personal data, or when a customer asks how vendors are checked
When the vendor sends a data processing agreement, to check each term and the edits to ask for
When the vendor is an AI tool, to flag data-training, liability and model-change terms

tasks.task: Run intake for a new vendor or tool

items.when: When someone wants a new tool that will touch personal data, card data or company systems
When you need a risk tier, tailored questions and a read of the vendor's assurance report
When the vendor's contract arrives, to get a risk rating and clauses to question

tasks.task: Draft privacy page notes for a lawyer to finish

items.when: When you know the business facts and country and need a draft privacy, terms or cookie page
When you want a second draft with a review checklist to compare against the first
When a page exists, to find where it no longer matches what the business does
When the notes are drafted, to have a fresh reviewer read them as a customer would

tasks.task: Review who can see what

items.when: Before a role or system change, to review who can reach staff or customer data
When accounts have piled up, to find old logins, inactive users and too much access
When everyone has access just in case, to weigh what each grant really protects

tasks.task: Handle a data request or a suspected breach

items.when: When someone asks for their data, to get the steps to find it and a draft reply
When an alert may be a breach, to set severity, who to tell and what to preserve
After the event, to write a blameless report and a tracked list of prevention actions
When an exposure notice arrives, to separate what is known from what is feared

tasks.task: Build the AI use register and screen it against the AI Act

items.when: When staff use AI tools and you need a list of what is used and a first screen against the Act
When a system may be high risk, to get a first read of risk level, duties and gaps
When one AI use needs its risks, the rules that apply and conditions written down
When a new AI law lands, to find gaps against current practice and a fix plan
When a tool on the register has terms that may allow training on company data

tasks.task: Prepare for a SOC 2, ISO 27001 or PCI DSS check

items.when: When a customer asks for a SOC 2 report or ISO certificate, or the acquirer for PCI validation
When the target is SOC 2, to map controls, find gaps and list what the auditor will ask for
When the target is ISO 27001, to find gaps to fix before an internal or outside audit
When the business takes cards, to find its PCI level, the right self-check form and gaps
Before the auditor arrives, to get a gap table, a proof list and a fix order

tasks.task: Build the control register and evidence pack

items.when: When scope is set and you need a control register, evidence map and a request list
When a review date is fixed and evidence must be gathered and indexed in order
When the auditor sends requests, to match each to evidence and track what is open
When a control must be tested, to pick a sample, fill a workpaper and rate any gap

tasks.task: Answer a customer's security questionnaire

items.when: When a questionnaire arrives, to draft sourced answers and an evidence index
When the questionnaire is long, to sort the must-haves and see where the business fits
When a question asks for a policy, to see which policy covers it and where there is none
Before sending, to tie every yes to a policy, a setting or a report, or change the answer

tasks.task: Check policies against a rule or framework

items.when: When a rule changed, a customer sent a framework or an audit is coming
When a gap is confirmed, to propose small marked-up edits to the current policy
When a policy exists on paper only, to find the rules people really follow

tasks.task: Write a one-page policy staff can follow

items.when: When a policy must be drafted for the country and company size, with points for a lawyer
When an approved policy needs a plain explanation and a staff announcement
Some weeks later, to see if staff follow it and what gets in the way
When the policy is padded with legal filler, to write what staff must actually do

tasks.task: Build the 12-month governance and compliance calendar

items.when: At the start of a financial year, after a change of secretary, or when deadlines are missed
When the group has several companies, to list annual filings and due dates by place
Each quarter, to check last quarter's fixes and what to close before an audit

tasks.task: Prepare a board agenda and papers list

items.when: When a charity or school board needs clearer agendas, roles and committee duties
When the board must decide something and needs the evidence and options set out
Before the agenda, to see which filings, reviews and approvals fall due at this meeting

tasks.task: Write formal minutes and resolutions from notes

items.when: After a board, trustee or committee meeting, from rough notes or a transcript
When you want a second draft in a set format to compare against the first
When directors will approve a decision in writing with no meeting
When decisions and actions must go into one register with owners and dates

tasks.task: Run the quarterly compliance review

items.when: Every three months, with a light monthly check of deadlines
When a framework is in scope, to see new gaps and whether last quarter's fixes held
When contracts are part of the review, to list notice dates falling in the next quarter

tasks.task: Check privacy duties in another country or sector

items.when: When the business handles personal data in India
When the business handles health data or builds a health app for the US
When the client is an EU finance firm, or supplies IT to one
When US customers are a large share and the thresholds may be met

always.when: Before any summary, register or minutes go out, to catch typos and names spelt two ways

helpers.when: When a control needs a technical fix, such as sign-in, backups, logging or device settings
When access must be changed or accounts removed after the review
When the policy is about employment, such as leave, conduct or grievances
When the vendor must be chosen or its price and terms negotiated
When the board needs a pack with numbers and a decision brief, not only records
When the rule is about health, safety, quality or the environment on a site

gaps: No library item writes terms of reference for a board committee
No library item decides if a breach must be reported, or drafts the notice to the regulator and to the people affected
No library item builds a retention schedule that says how long each record is kept and why
No library item writes a company board agenda with a papers list; the one that exists is for nonprofit boards
No library item compares two versions of a regulation clause by clause
No library item builds records of processing or a data map from scratch; only the kit skill does
No library item checks a cookie banner and consent set-up against the rules
No library item keeps statutory registers such as directors, members and people with control
No library item covers product rules such as labelling, product safety or food rules for a small firm
No library item keeps a conflicts of interest register or a gifts register
No library item writes the ISO 27001 statement of applicability
No library item gives clearly different versions of a policy or notice to compare
